{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineered]] a perfect '''assassin''', but the creature proved to be uncontrollable and unstoppable. Possessed of a cunning intelligence and physical superiority, it had the ability to mimic voices and could blend into the natural environment like a chameleon. After [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] team that had created it, the creature placed itself in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] until new prey presented itself. After a great deal of time, the creature was released by [[expedition IL5]] who were investigating the ruins of the bio-engineering base used to create the creature. Free from its slumber, the creature began to stalk and kill the research team.
